decisions.label: Full packs from phase
decisions.note: The phase whose islands reach full packs at their last stump (population.swarm.fullPhase; Ed, 2026-11-04: "we should rebalance this so phase 5 islands get to full packs"): an island of phase p reaches p over this of the way along the curve; home by the share of the islands found. Lower: earlier islands reach fuller packs. A new map: it reloads.
